row: DOWNEY Shelter Dogs. Don't shop, ADOPT!!!

Shelter animal rescue and networking. Primarily Downey Shelter, outside of Los Angeles. Focus is on adult dogs, hard to place and ones that have been at the shelter awhile. Google animal ID, starts with 'A', along with Petharbor.com to get more info on dogs up for adoption. Please adopt or rescue!
